tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Full Name and Address of the Bidder, Telephone Number

The bidder shall attach a certificate issued by the EPF Department confirming the EPF payment details for the total number of personnel deployed by the bidder across various institutions during the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

The bidder shall attach a currently valid EPF Registration Certificate issued by the concerned department and a certificate issued by the concerned department as proof of EPF payment for the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The bidder shall also submit the documents as specified in the Annexure.

The bidder shall attach a currently valid ESI Registration Certificate issued by the concerned department and a No Objection Certificate issued by the concerned department as proof of ESI payment for the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The bidder shall also submit the documents as specified in the Annexure

The bidder shall attach a currently valid GST Registration Certificate issued by the concerned department and a certificate issued by the concerned department as proof of GST payment for the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The bidder shall also submit the documents as specified in Annexure.

The bidder shall attach a valid Registration Certificate in Form C under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961, issued by the Labour Department. The certificate must remain valid during the tender invitation period.

The bidder shall attach a valid Trade License Certificate for the financial year 2026 -27, issued by the competent authority of the concerned Local Municipality Town Panchayat Municipal Council Municipal Corporation, evidencing the registration of the establishment and authorization to operate the business

The bidder shall attach an income tax payment certificate issued by the concerned department for the three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, along with a PAN Card registered in the name of the establishment.
The bidder shall attach Form D as proof of payment of the Labour Welfare Fund for the workers employed in the bidders establishment for the financial year 2025-26.

The bidder shall attach the Registration Certificate under the Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, along with the Professional Tax Clearance Certificate for the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

The bidder shall have an annual turnover of not less than Rs 10 Crores for each of the three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The audited financial statements certified by a Chartered Accountant shall be submitted. The Net Worth Certificate must contain a UDIN Number

The bidder shall mandatorily submit a valid Registration Certificate in Form No 6 issued by the Labour Department under the Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act and a currently valid Labour License obtained from the Assistant Labour Commissioner for the services relating to the posts concerned, covering a minimum of 100 personnel.

The bidder shall submit a Bank Solvency Certificate for 10 percent of the tender value. The Solvency Certificate shall be issued in the name of the Director, Kodagu Institute of Medical Sciences, Madikeri

The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on a Rs 100 stamp paper declaring that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any institution where a contract was previously awarded and that no cases relating to PF, ESI or GST payments are pending before any court of law.

The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on a Rs 100 stamp paper undertaking to submit a Bank Guarantee equivalent to 5 percent of the annual contract value, valid throughout the contract period, after being awarded the contract and before obtaining the work order

The bidder shall submit experience certificates for providing manpower services to Government Offices or Institutions, Semi Government Offices or Institutions, Government Medical Sciences Institutions and Government Hospitals, with a minimum of 300 manpower personnel, for the three financial years
The establishment shall be ISO registered and possess a valid ISO certificate. The bidder shall attach a currently valid ISO 9001 2015 certificate for Quality Management Systems QMS

The security agency shall attach a copy of the currently valid license issued by the Police Department in accordance with the Private Security Agencies Regulation Act 2005 and the Karnataka Private Security Agencies Rules 2008.
